analysis.intent_details: Sending job alert notifications for front end developer positions in Karachi

responses.subject: Re: Junior Developer at Digital Arcanum and 5 more front end developer jobs in karachi for you!
responses.body:
Dear Indeed Team,

Thank you for the job alert email. I have received the notification about 6 new front end developer positions in Karachi, including the Junior Developer position at Digital Arcanum.

I will review these opportunities and visit the Indeed website to explore the matching results as suggested.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
responses.rationale: A professional acknowledgment confirms receipt of the job alert while expressing intent to review the opportunities. This maintains professional communication with the job alert service.
